document.title: Rumsfeld snowflake to Larry Di Rita, "Weekly Meeting on Afghanistan"
document.authors: Office of the Secretary of Defense (Donald Rumsfeld)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), Afghanistan 20/20: The 20-Year War in 20 Documents | National Security Archive
document.note: [Unclassified] After the swift victory over the Taliban, Rumsfeld worried by March 2002 that Afghanistan was 'drifting' and asked for a weekly meeting. The same day, in a public interview, he said there was no point negotiating with Taliban remnants.
